         <h2 class="project-title">Mortgage Knowledge Retrieval &amp; Grounded Answers</h2>
         <p class="project-subhead">BM25 · Hybrid Retrieval · Citations</p>
         <div class="detail-tools"><span class="label">Executed notebook · Read-only website version</span>

         <div class="nb-container"><div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=89798e8e"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<p><strong>Track:</strong> LLM / RAG<br/>
<strong>Research / product question:</strong> Can an assistant retrieve the right policy and justify every answer with current evidence?</p>
<p><strong>Learning outcome:</strong> Implement BM25 and hybrid retrieval, tune retrieval parameters, evaluate citation coverage and define a pluggable generation interface.</p>
<p><strong>Workflow:</strong> Data-generating process → raw-data audit → leakage-safe features → from-scratch baseline → model selection / hyperparameter tuning → held-out evaluation → failure analysis.</p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>Synthetic-data disclosure:</strong> All records and outcomes are created in this notebook; they do not describe real customers or credit decisions. Ground truth is constructed for teaching. Numerical results are illustrative of this simulator, not estimates of real-world business impact.</p>
</blockquote>
<p><strong>Reproducibility:</strong> Random seeds are fixed. Run cells top-to-bottom. Install packages from the project-level <code>requirements.txt</code>. CPU execution is supported; deep-learning examples deliberately use small models.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=c777e5c6"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<blockquote>
<p><strong>Portfolio standard:</strong> fully reproducible, synthetic educational data · explicit evaluation protocol · plots and failure analysis · no claims of production accuracy.</p>
</blockquote>
<p>A fully runnable <em>offline</em> retrieval pipeline compares BM25, SVD-based low-rank semantic retrieval and reciprocal-rank fusion. The answerer quotes a supporting policy and returns its policy ID.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="1.-Simulate-a-versioned-mortgage-servicing-knowledge-base">1. Simulate a versioned mortgage servicing knowledge base</h2><p>A synthetic handbook provides explicit effective dates, policy rules and references. These rules are fictional—<strong>not legal, financial or servicing advice</strong>. Several near-duplicate policies make retrieval more realistic.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing code_cell rendered" id="cell-id=0382aea3">
<details class="code-block" open=""><summary>Python source · Cell 2</summary><div class="input">
<div class="inner_cell">
<div class="input_area">
<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Fictional mortgage-servicing policies must not be treated as regulatory guidance.</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">sklearn.feature_extraction.text</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">TfidfVectorizer</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">sklearn.decomposition</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">TruncatedSVD</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">sklearn.metrics.pairwise</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">cosine_similarity</span>
<span class="n">policies</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span>
<span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'P01'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Payment grace period'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'A regular monthly payment is considered late for fee purposes after a fictional 14 day grace period.'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'grace'</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'P02'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Late fees'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'A fictional late fee can be 3 percent of overdue principal and interest after the grace period, subject to account restrictions.'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'fee'</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'P03'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Escrow shortage'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'A borrower with an escrow shortage can request a repayment plan under the fictional servicing policy.'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'escrow'</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'P04'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Extra principal'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'A borrower may designate an extra payment for principal reduction subject to loan terms.'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'prepay'</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'P05'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Refinance application'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Refinancing replaces a loan and involves a new underwriting decision and closing costs.'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'refinance'</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'P06'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Assistance review'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Borrowers with documented hardship may request assistance review; approval is not guaranteed.'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'assistance'</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'P07'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Loan modification'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'A modification request may change monthly payments only if the borrower qualifies after review.'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'modification'</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'P08'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Insurance renewal'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Insurance renewal documents may affect escrow estimates when premiums change.'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'insurance'</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'P09'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Credit reporting'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Servicers may report payment history according to applicable program and reporting rules.'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'credit'</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'P10'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Home equity'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Home equity is the difference between a property value and secured loan balances.'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'equity'</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'P11'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Payment due date'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Monthly payments are ordinarily scheduled for the date specified in the loan contract.'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'due'</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'P12'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Customer complaints'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'The fictional servicer logs complaints with a case number and escalation contact.'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'complaint'</span><span class="p">)]</span>
<span class="n">docs</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">pd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">DataFrame</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">policies</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">columns</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'id'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'title'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'body'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'intent'</span><span class="p">]);</span><span class="n">docs</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'text'</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">docs</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">title</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="s1">'. '</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="n">docs</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">body</span>
<span class="n">questions</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span>
<span class="s1">'grace'</span><span class="p">:[</span><span class="s1">'How many days is the grace period?'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'When is a payment late for fees?'</span><span class="p">],</span>
<span class="s1">'fee'</span><span class="p">:[</span><span class="s1">'How are overdue late fees determined?'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'What is the missed payment fee?'</span><span class="p">],</span>
<span class="s1">'escrow'</span><span class="p">:[</span><span class="s1">'Can I spread out an escrow shortage?'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'How do I handle escrow deficit?'</span><span class="p">],</span>
<span class="s1">'prepay'</span><span class="p">:[</span><span class="s1">'Can I make extra principal payments?'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Does paying extra reduce principal?'</span><span class="p">],</span>
<span class="s1">'refinance'</span><span class="p">:[</span><span class="s1">'Do I have to apply for a refinance?'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Does refinancing incur closing costs?'</span><span class="p">],</span>
<span class="s1">'assistance'</span><span class="p">:[</span><span class="s1">'Can I ask for hardship assistance?'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Is hardship help automatically approved?'</span><span class="p">],</span>
<span class="s1">'modification'</span><span class="p">:[</span><span class="s1">'How do loan modifications work?'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Can payments change under a modification?'</span><span class="p">],</span>
<span class="s1">'insurance'</span><span class="p">:[</span><span class="s1">'Why does my insurance increase escrow?'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'What affects insurance renewal escrow?'</span><span class="p">],</span>
<span class="s1">'credit'</span><span class="p">:[</span><span class="s1">'Will late payments appear on my credit record?'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'How is repayment reported to credit bureaus?'</span><span class="p">],</span>
<span class="s1">'equity'</span><span class="p">:[</span><span class="s1">'What does home equity mean?'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Is my property value minus debt my equity?'</span><span class="p">],</span>
<span class="s1">'due'</span><span class="p">:[</span><span class="s1">'Where can I find my payment due date?'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'When is my monthly mortgage bill due?'</span><span class="p">],</span>
<span class="s1">'complaint'</span><span class="p">:[</span><span class="s1">'How to submit a complaint?'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'Where can I escalate a servicing issue?'</span><span class="p">]}</span>
<span class="n">qdf</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">pd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">DataFrame</span><span class="p">([(</span><span class="n">q</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">t</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">t</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">qs</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">questions</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">items</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">q</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">qs</span><span class="p">],</span><span class="n">columns</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'query'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'intent'</span><span class="p">]);</span><span class="n">qid</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="n">t</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">i</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">t</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">enumerate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">docs</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">intent</span><span class="p">)};</span><span class="n">qdf</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'target_id'</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">qdf</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">intent</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">map</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">qid</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Documents:'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">docs</span><span class="p">),</span><span class="s1">'Evaluation questions:'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">qdf</span><span class="p">));</span><span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">docs</span><span class="p">[[</span><span class="s1">'id'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'title'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'body'</span><span class="p">]]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">head</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_string</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">index</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">False</span><span class="p">))</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</div>
</div></details>
<div class="output_wrapper">
<div class="output">
<div class="output_area">
<div class="output_subarea output_stream output_stdout output_text">
<pre>Documents: 12 Evaluation questions: 24
 id                 title                                                                                                                             body
P01  Payment grace period                             A regular monthly payment is considered late for fee purposes after a fictional 14 day grace period.
P02             Late fees A fictional late fee can be 3 percent of overdue principal and interest after the grace period, subject to account restrictions.
P03       Escrow shortage                            A borrower with an escrow shortage can request a repayment plan under the fictional servicing policy.
P04       Extra principal                                         A borrower may designate an extra payment for principal reduction subject to loan terms.
P05 Refinance application                                          Refinancing replaces a loan and involves a new underwriting decision and closing costs.
</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=5759e0a0"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="2.-Implement-BM25,-dense-SVD-and-hybrid-retrieval">2. Implement BM25, dense SVD and hybrid retrieval</h2><p>The dense branch is TF-IDF projected with SVD, <strong>not a pretrained semantic embedding model</strong>. This makes every operation transparent offline; stronger models can be plugged in later. RRF combines lexical and dense ranks.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing code_cell rendered" id="cell-id=b975d57f">
<details class="code-block"><summary>Python source · Cell 3</summary><div class="input">
<div class="inner_cell">
<div class="input_area">
<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Implement lexical BM25 and low-rank SVD retrieval without hosted APIs.</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">collections</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Counter</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">re</span>
<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">tok</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">s</span><span class="p">):</span><span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">re</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">findall</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">r</span><span class="s1">'[a-z]+'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">s</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lower</span><span class="p">())</span>
<span class="n">corpus</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">tok</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">x</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">x</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">docs</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">];</span><span class="n">dfreq</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">Counter</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">w</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">d</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">corpus</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">w</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">d</span><span class="p">));</span><span class="n">tf</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">Counter</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">d</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">d</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">corpus</span><span class="p">];</span><span class="n">N</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">corpus</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="n">avg</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">d</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">d</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">corpus</span><span class="p">])</span>
<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">bm25</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">query</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">k1</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">1.2</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">b</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">.75</span><span class="p">):</span>
 <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[]</span>
 <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">d</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">enumerate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">corpus</span><span class="p">):</span>
  <span class="n">val</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.</span>
  <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">w</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">tok</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">query</span><span class="p">):</span>
   <span class="n">n</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">dfreq</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">w</span><span class="p">];</span><span class="n">idf</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">log</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">N</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mf">.5</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">/</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mf">.5</span><span class="p">));</span><span class="n">f</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">tf</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="n">w</span><span class="p">]</span>
   <span class="n">val</span><span class="o">+=</span><span class="n">idf</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">f</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">k1</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">/</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">f</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="n">k1</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n">b</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="n">b</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">d</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">/</span><span class="n">avg</span><span class="p">))</span>
  <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">val</span><span class="p">)</span>
 <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">array</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">result</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">vectorizer</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">TfidfVectorizer</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">ngram_range</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">))</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">fit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">docs</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="n">dt</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">vectorizer</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">transform</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">docs</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">svd</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">TruncatedSVD</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">n_components</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="nb">min</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">8</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">dt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">shape</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">),</span><span class="n">random_state</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">42</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">fit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dt</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">dense_docs</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">svd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">transform</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dt</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">dense</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">query</span><span class="p">):</span><span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">cosine_similarity</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">svd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">transform</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">vectorizer</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">transform</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="n">query</span><span class="p">])),</span><span class="n">dense_docs</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ravel</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">rrf</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">q</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">k1</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">1.2</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">rrf_k</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">15</span><span class="p">):</span>
 <span class="n">a</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">argsort</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n">bm25</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">q</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">k1</span><span class="p">));</span><span class="n">b</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">argsort</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n">dense</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">q</span><span class="p">));</span><span class="n">ranks_a</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">argsort</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">a</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="n">ranks_b</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">argsort</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">b</span><span class="p">)</span>
 <span class="k">return</span> <span class="mi">1</span><span class="o">/</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">rrf_k</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="n">ranks_a</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="o">/</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">rrf_k</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="n">ranks_b</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Retrieval candidate:'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">docs</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">iloc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">argmax</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">rrf</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Can I prepay extra principal?'</span><span class="p">))]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">title</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</div>
</div></details>
<div class="output_wrapper">
<div class="output">
<div class="output_area">
<div class="output_subarea output_stream output_stdout output_text">
<pre>Retrieval candidate: Extra principal
</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=7d6ed7aa"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="3.-Tune-on-validation-questions,-then-test-once">3. Tune on validation questions, then test once</h2><p>Split questions by paraphrase index (one phrasing for validation, one for test). Optimizing against all questions would overstate retrieval performance. We tune BM25 k1 and RRF constant.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing code_cell rendered" id="cell-id=f00f7193">
<details class="code-block"><summary>Python source · Cell 4</summary><div class="input">
<div class="inner_cell">
<div class="input_area">
<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Tune only on validation paraphrases; evaluate on untouched questions.</span>
<span class="n">val</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">qdf</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">iloc</span><span class="p">[::</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">reset_index</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">drop</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="n">test</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">qdf</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">iloc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">::</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">reset_index</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">drop</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">recall_at_k</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">query_df</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">scorer</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">k</span><span class="p">):</span>
 <span class="n">correct</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[]</span>
 <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">row</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">query_df</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">itertuples</span><span class="p">():</span><span class="n">correct</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">row</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">target_id</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">argsort</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n">scorer</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">row</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">query</span><span class="p">))[:</span><span class="n">k</span><span class="p">])</span>
 <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">correct</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">configs</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[]</span>
<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">k1</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="mf">.5</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mf">1.5</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mf">2.3</span><span class="p">]:</span>
 <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">k</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">5</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mi">20</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mi">60</span><span class="p">]:</span><span class="n">configs</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="n">k1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">k</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">recall_at_k</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">val</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="k">lambda</span> <span class="n">q</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">rrf</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">q</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">k1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">k</span><span class="p">),</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">)))</span>
<span class="n">bk1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">brrf</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">_</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">configs</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">key</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="k">lambda</span> <span class="n">a</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">a</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">]);</span><span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Validation search:'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">configs</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'selected:'</span><span class="p">,(</span><span class="n">bk1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">brrf</span><span class="p">))</span>
<span class="n">metrics</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="s1">'BM25'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">recall_at_k</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">test</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">bm25</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">),</span><span class="s1">'SVD dense'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">recall_at_k</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">test</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">dense</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">),</span><span class="s1">'Hybrid RRF'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">recall_at_k</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">test</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="k">lambda</span> <span class="n">q</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">rrf</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">q</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">bk1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">brrf</span><span class="p">),</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">)}</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Unseen paraphrase Recall@2:'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">metrics</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">fig</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">ax</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">plt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">subplots</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">figsize</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">7</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">));</span><span class="n">ax</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">bar</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">list</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">metrics</span><span class="p">),</span><span class="nb">list</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">metrics</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">values</span><span class="p">()));</span><span class="n">ax</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">ylim</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">),</span><span class="n">ylabel</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'Recall@2'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">title</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'Retrieval held-out performance'</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="n">plt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">show</span><span class="p">()</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</div>
</div></details>

<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=6a1b133e"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="4.-Grounded-answering-and-citations">4. Grounded answering and citations</h2><p>A real LLM can be swapped in via the generator interface below. <strong>The default offline answerer is extractive, NOT an LLM.</strong> That distinction matters: retrieval evaluation is reproducible locally, while generative factuality requires a separate model and evaluation.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing code_cell rendered" id="cell-id=53773cd9">
<details class="code-block"><summary>Python source · Cell 5</summary><div class="input">
<div class="inner_cell">
<div class="input_area">
<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Return policy-ID evidence and flag limitations of extractive answering.</span>
<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">retrieve</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">query</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">k</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">):</span>
 <span class="n">scores</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">rrf</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">query</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">bk1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">brrf</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">docs</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">iloc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">argsort</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n">scores</span><span class="p">)[:</span><span class="n">k</span><span class="p">]]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">copy</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">grounded_extract</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">query</span><span class="p">):</span>
 <span class="n">matched</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">retrieve</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">query</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">)</span>
 <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">matched</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">empty</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s1">'answer'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="s1">'I cannot locate supporting policy.'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'citations'</span><span class="p">:[]}</span>
 <span class="n">top</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">matched</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">iloc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span>
 <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s1">'answer'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">top</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">body</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'citations'</span><span class="p">:[</span><span class="n">top</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">id</span><span class="p">],</span><span class="s1">'policy_title'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">top</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">title</span><span class="p">}</span>
<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">question</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'Can I make extra principal payments?'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'How do loan modifications work?'</span><span class="p">]:</span>
 <span class="n">response</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">grounded_extract</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">question</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s1">Q:'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">question</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s1">A:'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">response</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">coverage</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="n">docs</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">iloc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">row</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">target_id</span><span class="p">)]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">id</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">grounded_extract</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">row</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">query</span><span class="p">)[</span><span class="s1">'citations'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">row</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">test</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">itertuples</span><span class="p">()])</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s1">Held-out top-one grounded evidence match:'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">coverage</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">))</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</div>
</div></details>
<div class="output_wrapper">
<div class="output">
<div class="output_area">
<div class="output_subarea output_stream output_stdout output_text">
<pre>
Q: Can I make extra principal payments? 
A: {'answer': 'A borrower may designate an extra payment for principal reduction subject to loan terms.', 'citations': ['P04'], 'policy_title': 'Extra principal'}

Q: How do loan modifications work? 
A: {'answer': 'Home equity is the difference between a property value and secured loan balances.', 'citations': ['P10'], 'policy_title': 'Home equity'}

Held-out top-one grounded evidence match: 0.833
</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=fa89d0fd"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="5.-Optional-local-LLM-generation-adapter-(not-executed-by-default)">5. Optional local LLM generation adapter (not executed by default)</h2><p>To turn retrieval into a <strong>generative</strong> RAG system, replace the extractive step with a locally available Hugging Face instruction model. This deliberately avoids downloading model weights during tests and will only work when <code>transformers</code> and an appropriate checkpoint are installed locally. Output must still be checked for support.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing code_cell rendered" id="cell-id=31394ee1">
<details class="code-block"><summary>Python source · Cell 6</summary><div class="input">
<div class="inner_cell">
<div class="input_area">
<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Return policy-ID evidence and flag limitations of extractive answering.</span>

<span class="c1"># evidence = retrieve("Can I change a mortgage payment?", k=2)</span>

<span class="c1">#           + "\n".join(</span>
<span class="c1">#     f"[{r.id}] {r.body}" for r in evidence.itertuples())</span>
<span class="c1"># ... tokenize prompt, call llm.generate(...), decode and check citations.</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Offline deliverable: fully working retrieval + extractive grounded answers. LLM generation is an explicit extension.'</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</div>
</div></details>

<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=d9a88a4d"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="What-the-results-mean-/-interview-discussion">What the results mean / interview discussion</h2><p>This notebook demonstrates an auditable retrieval + grounding stack and separates offline <strong>document match quality</strong> from language generation quality. The text uses fictional rules and can never be used to answer real servicing-policy questions. The generation adapter is intentionally optional, so the benchmark runs without credentials, internet access or a GPU.</p>
<p><strong>Try explaining these without looking at the code:</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>How do Recall@K, answer correctness and citation correctness differ?</li>
<li>What are retrieval leakage and document versioning failures?</li>
<li>How would you replace SVD with a trained dense bi-encoder and a cross-encoder reranker?</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Limitations and next step:</strong> Evaluate on a suitably licensed real-world dataset or stronger simulation with domain shift, logging bias and realistic selection. Never treat synthetic performance as production evidence.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=d6cf0b52"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="What-this-project-demonstrates,-and-what-it-does-not">What this project demonstrates, and what it does not</h2><p><strong>Scope:</strong> The executable path is a <strong>retrieval + extractive evidence assistant</strong>, not a benchmark of a deployed generative LLM. The notebook provides an optional local-model integration hook but no model weights. <strong>Next:</strong> add an actual instruction LLM, citations verification, abstention thresholds, policy versioning, and adversarial outdated documents.</p>
<p><strong>Reproduce:</strong> <code>Run All</code> in Jupyter; no private or uploaded data required. For real data, use leakage-safe train/validation/test partitions and respect each dataset license.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing code_cell rendered" id="cell-id=23158f8b">
<details class="code-block"><summary>Python source · Cell 7</summary><div class="input">
<div class="inner_cell">
<div class="input_area">
<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Honest failure analysis: list held-out questions answered from the wrong policy.</span>
<span class="n">failures</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[]</span>
<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">row</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">test</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">itertuples</span><span class="p">():</span>
    <span class="n">answer</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">grounded_extract</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">row</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">query</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">expected_id</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">docs</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">iloc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">row</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">target_id</span><span class="p">)]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">id</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">expected_id</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">answer</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"citations"</span><span class="p">]:</span>
        <span class="n">failures</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="s2">"question"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">row</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">query</span><span class="p">,</span>
                         <span class="s2">"expected_policy"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">expected_id</span><span class="p">,</span>
                         <span class="s2">"retrieved_policy"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">answer</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"citations"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]})</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"Unreliable evidence matches:"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">failures</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="s2">"of"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">test</span><span class="p">))</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">DataFrame</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">failures</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">head</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">10</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_string</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">index</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">False</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">failures</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="s2">"None"</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</div>
</div></details>

<div class="output">
<div class="output_area">
<div class="output_subarea output_stream output_stdout output_text">
<pre>Unreliable evidence matches: 2 of 12
                               question expected_policy retrieved_policy
        What is the missed payment fee?             P02              P01
Where can I escalate a servicing issue?             P12              P03
</pre>
</div>
</div>

<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=5f851cb1"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<p><strong>Safety of demonstrations:</strong> When retrieval finds a wrong policy, the extractive answer also becomes wrong. Do not treat a citation as evidence of correctness unless the citation is independently verified. Production assistants need abstention, current-policy checks and an evaluated generation layer.</p>
</div>
